evidence_location.quote: Cytokines and chemokines were measured using a multiplex ELISA-based assay (Luminex). All serum samples were inactivated with a UV-C lamp (254 nm) for 10 min on ice in a biosafety-level 3 laboratory at the University of California, Berkeley. Each sample was run in duplicate in a 96-well microtiter plate using 25 µl serum from each patient from acute and convalescent timepoints using the multiplex cytokine panels (Multiplex High Sensitivity Human Cytokine Panel, Millipore Corp.). Forty analytes (cytokines and chemokines) were measured using a Luminex-200 system and the XMap Platform (Luminex Corporation).
